title: clodex repo profile
description: <repo>/.clodex/profile.json — the one clodex file a repository commits. Generated by the clodex router on first run from repo inspection plus a short interview, and updated non-destructively thereafter. It tells clodex how this repo builds, tests, versions, releases, and proves itself live, and which external actions clodex may propose here. Nullable fields are nullable on purpose: an explicit null ("this repo has no changelog") is a recorded fact, while an omitted field is an unanswered question.

schema_version.description: Profile contract version. 1 for clodex v0.1.

commands.description: Shell commands, run from the repo root. Every key is present; null means this repo genuinely has none. An omitted gate is silently skipped at verify, which is how offline-green runs hide real defects.

install.description: Dependency install, when a fresh checkout needs one before anything else runs.

version.description: Where the authoritative version lives. Ship reads this file at release time; it never trusts a version copied into the profile.

source.description: Repo-relative path holding the version, e.g. package.json, pyproject.toml, VERSION. Null when the repo is unversioned.

field.description: Dotted key inside `source`, e.g. "version" or "project.version". Null when the whole file is the version string.

bump_rule.description: How the next version is chosen (e.g. "semver, minor for features"). Guidance for the human decision, not an automation input.

work_on_default.description: True when a run may commit directly to the default branch. False when every run works on its own branch.

naming.description: Pattern for run branches when work_on_default is false, e.g. "clodex/<run-id>".

enabled.description: False when this repo does not tag releases.

format.description: Tag pattern, e.g. "v{version}". Null when enabled is false.

changelog.description: Null when this repo keeps no changelog.

path.description: Repo-relative file, or the directory releases are written into.

style.description: House convention, e.g. "keep-a-changelog" or "one file per release".

docs.description: Where clodex reads context from and writes plans to.

architecture.description: Repo-relative docs a plan must be grounded in before proposing structure.

plans_dir.description: Where clodex-plan writes plan files, e.g. "docs/plans".

deploy.description: Null when this repo does not deploy — ship then closes at the explicit not-deployed boundary instead of guessing.

target.description: Where a release lands, e.g. "Vercel project <name>, production".

trigger.description: How a deploy starts. manual-command means an entry in `actions` performs it; external means a person or system outside clodex does.

verify_live.description: Checks that prove the new release is actually serving. Empty means live state cannot be verified here — ship must record that boundary rather than assume success.

check.description: Shell command that exits 0 only when the new release is live.

release_owner.description: Who owns the release machinery. Optional; omitted means "run" — the run itself books, commits, tags, pushes, deploys per this profile. "external" declares the orchestrated-lane shape: the run's deliverable is a reviewed branch plus a handoff artifact, release actions belong to an external orchestrator, and ship's terminal state for a fully successful lane is `handed-off`, not `abandoned`. Deliberately not part of schema_version 1's required set: an old install that never reads this key behaves exactly as today.

evidence.description: What proof this repo expects by default. A plan may declare more; declaring less is an argued exception, recorded in the plan.

default_classes.description: tests = automated suites · real-data = run against production-shaped input · live-check = the deployed thing observed working · visual = rendered output reviewed.

runtimes.description: Checked by preflight before any stage runs, so a missing toolchain fails in seconds rather than mid-build. Required: an omitted list turns that check into a permanent no-op, so a repo with nothing to check says so with []. Derive entries from package.json engines, .nvmrc, .tool-versions, or pyproject.toml requires-python rather than asking.

version_command.description: Command that prints the version, required when min_version is set.

required_env.description: Credential and configuration variable NAMES this repo's commands need. Names only — never values. Preflight checks each is set with `printenv <NAME> >/dev/null` and never prints it. Required for the same reason as runtimes: a repo that needs none says so with [].

actions.description: The structured action policy: the exact release and deploy actions clodex may propose in this repo. Nothing outside this list may be run at ship — a new action is added here and committed first.

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by a release authorization, e.g. push-main.

argv.description: Literal argv, never a shell string. {braced} placeholders are filled from run state (e.g. {version}, {tag}); the filled argv is what gets shown for approval and what gets run.

cwd.description: Repo-relative working directory; null means the repo root.

env_refs.description: Credential NAMES this action needs. Names only.

policy.description: auto-with-authorization: may run once the single consolidated release authorization at ship covers it. always-ask-exact: the literal filled argv is presented for approval every time it runs, in every run — for destructive or irreversible actions, and for repos with their own guardrail tiers.

notes.description: Free-form context for humans. Nothing in clodex reads this field. Anything that must change what clodex does belongs in a typed field above.
